regression-line.def: A line $\hat{y} = a + bx$ that describes how a response variable $y$ changes, on average, as an explanatory variable $x$ changes. Its output $\hat{y}$ (y-hat) is a predicted value of $y$.

extrapolation.def: Using a regression line to predict for values of $x$ outside the range of the data. Such predictions are unreliable because the pattern may not continue.
